profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Crayon
profile.summary: Experienced principal-level engineer who successfully brought AI into real production systems.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead engineer, part of dev leadership 

- Led adoption of AI and LLM engineering practices across the organization.

- Designed scalable prompt-chain architectures, evaluation workflows, and AI-powered product capabilities.

- Drove large-scale migration from monolithic systems to maintainable microservices.

- Mentored engineers across teams and helped establish engineering best practices and technical leadership culture.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built AI/ML-driven systems for entity resolution, geospatial deduplication, and golden record management.

- Helped re-architect core platform systems while rapidly delivering experimental product prototypes.

- Mentored engineers and contributed to a strong culture of technical excellence and innovation.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and led the team behind an AI-assisted essay grading platform used by university partners.

- Designed flexible grading systems supporting machine learning, peer review, and self-assessment workflows.

- Led cross-functional engineering efforts to deliver scalable educational tooling and preserve key academic partnerships.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed dynamic rendering systems driven by search behavior and guided navigation.

- Built highly adaptable search-based experiences using rule-driven content and presentation logic.

- Contributed to large-scale search and personalization technologies foundational to modern recommendation systems.
